## Introduction

Single-nucleus RNA-seq (10x On-Chip Multiplexing; GEO: GSE301590) of brain border tissue from control mice and mice 1 and 4 days after AEC injection (n = 4 per time point). Ambient RNA was removed with CellBender before this analysis.

Workflow:

1.  Per-sample quality control and doublet detection (scDblFinder)
2.  Integration across samples (rliger iNMF; Harmony and RPCA for comparison)
3.  Annotation of major cell types, then subclustering of immune cells, fibroblasts and epithelial cells
4.  Removal of neuronal contamination (Fgf14⁺ nuclei in non-neural clusters) and re-integration
5.  Cell-type proportions and differential expression between time points

Cell–cell communication (CellChat, NicheNet) is in `02_advanced_analysis.qmd`, which starts from the objects saved here.

**Input files**

| File | Content |
|----|----|
| `data/snrna/cellbender/<sample>/cellbender_raw_feature_bc_matrix_filtered.h5` | CellBender output, one folder per sample (`Ctrl1`–`Ctrl4`, `D1_1`–`D1_4`, `D4_1`–`D4_4`) |

Outputs are written to `results/snrna/`; intermediate Seurat objects to `results/snrna/objects/`.

## Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(scCustomize)        # Read_CellBender_h5_Mat()
library(scDblFinder)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(gprofiler2)
library(rliger)
library(ggalluvial)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(tidydr)

# Paths
cellbender_dir <- "data/snrna/cellbender"
results_dir    <- "results/snrna"
obj_dir        <- file.path(results_dir, "objects")
qc_dir         <- file.path(results_dir, "qc")
for (d in c(results_dir, obj_dir, qc_dir,
            file.path(results_dir, c("annotation", "condition")))) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

set.seed(42)

qc_features <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_mito", "percent_ribo",
                 "percent_hb", "percent_plat", "S.Score", "G2M.Score")
regress_vars <- c("nCount_RNA", "percent_mito", "percent_ribo", "S.Score", "G2M.Score")
```

### Samples and QC thresholds

QC thresholds were set per sample after inspecting the QC plots; the expected doublet rate depends on the number of nuclei recovered per sample.

```{r samples}
samples <- tribble(
  ~folder, ~sample_id, ~group, ~min_features, ~max_mito, ~max_ribo, ~doublet_rate,
  "Ctrl1", "Ctrl_1",   "Ctrl", 100,           10,         7,         0.04,
  "Ctrl2", "Ctrl_2",   "Ctrl", 100,            5,         5,         0.04,
  "Ctrl3", "Ctrl_3",   "Ctrl", 100,           10,         7.5,       0.07,
  "Ctrl4", "Ctrl_4",   "Ctrl", 100,           12,        12,         0.08,
  "D1_1",  "D1_1",     "D1",   300,           10,         8,         0.02,
  "D1_2",  "D1_2",     "D1",   100,           10,         6,         0.03,
  "D1_3",  "D1_3",     "D1",   100,           18,        12,         0.08,
  "D1_4",  "D1_4",     "D1",   100,           10,         7,         0.08,
  "D4_1",  "D4_1",     "D4",   100,           10,         5,         0.03,
  "D4_2",  "D4_2",     "D4",   100,            9,         6,         0.03,
  "D4_3",  "D4_3",     "D4",   100,           10,         5,         0.05,
  "D4_4",  "D4_4",     "D4",   100,           12,         8,         0.08
)
knitr::kable(samples)
```

## Per-sample quality control

```{r qc-functions}
# Mouse orthologues of the Seurat cell-cycle genes
cc_genes <- list(
  s   = gorth(cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes,   source_organism = "hsapiens", target_organism = "mmusculus")$ortholog_name,
  g2m = gorth(cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes, source_organism = "hsapiens", target_organism = "mmusculus")$ortholog_name
)

plot_top_genes <- function(obj, file, n = 20) {
  counts <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  counts@x <- counts@x / rep.int(Matrix::colSums(counts), diff(counts@p)) * 100
  top <- order(Matrix::rowSums(counts), decreasing = TRUE)[n:1]
  pdf(file, width = 12, height = 6)
  boxplot(as.matrix(Matrix::t(counts[top, ])), cex = 0.1, las = 1,
          xlab = "Percent of counts per nucleus",
          col = scales::hue_pal()(n)[n:1], horizontal = TRUE)
  dev.off()
}

preprocess_sample <- function(s) {
  message("Processing ", s$sample_id)
  counts <- Read_CellBender_h5_Mat(file.path(cellbender_dir, s$folder,
                                             "cellbender_raw_feature_bc_matrix_filtered.h5"))
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts, project = "AEC_border", min.cells = 3, min.features = 100)
  obj$SampleID <- s$sample_id
  obj$Group    <- s$group

  obj <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, "^mt-",         col.name = "percent_mito")
  obj <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, "^Rp[sl]",      col.name = "percent_ribo")
  obj <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, "^Hb[^(p|e|s)]", col.name = "percent_hb")
  obj <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, "Pecam1|Pf4",   col.name = "percent_plat")
  obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
  obj <- CellCycleScoring(obj, s.features = cc_genes$s, g2m.features = cc_genes$g2m)

  p <- VlnPlot(obj, features = qc_features, group.by = "SampleID",
               pt.size = 0.01, alpha = 0.1, ncol = 4) & NoLegend()
  ggsave(file.path(qc_dir, paste0(s$folder, "_QC_raw.pdf")), p, width = 10, height = 6)
  plot_top_genes(obj, file.path(qc_dir, paste0(s$folder, "_top20_genes.pdf")))

  n_before <- ncol(obj)
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > s$min_features &
                              percent_mito < s$max_mito &
                              percent_ribo < s$max_ribo)
  message("  ", n_before, " -> ", ncol(obj), " nuclei after QC")

  # Doublet detection on raw counts
  set.seed(42)
  sce <- scDblFinder(as.SingleCellExperiment(obj), dbr = s$doublet_rate)
  obj$scDblFinder.class <- sce$scDblFinder.class
  obj$scDblFinder.score <- sce$scDblFinder.score
  obj
}
```

```{r run-qc}
obj_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i) preprocess_sample(samples[i, ]))

DATA <- merge(obj_list[[1]], obj_list[-1],
              add.cell.ids = samples$folder, project = "AEC_border")
rm(obj_list)

table(DATA$scDblFinder.class, DATA$SampleID)

DATA <- subset(DATA, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")
DATA <- JoinLayers(DATA)
DATA$SampleID <- factor(DATA$SampleID, levels = samples$sample_id)
DATA$Group    <- factor(DATA$Group, levels = c("Ctrl", "D1", "D4"))

p <- VlnPlot(DATA, features = qc_features, group.by = "SampleID",
             pt.size = 0, ncol = 4) & NoLegend()
ggsave(file.path(qc_dir, "QC_all_samples_singlets.pdf"), p, width = 14, height = 8)

saveRDS(DATA, file.path(obj_dir, "01_merged_singlets.rds"))
```

## Integration

Samples are integrated with rliger (iNMF), which is used for clustering and the main UMAPs. Harmony and RPCA embeddings are computed for comparison; Harmony is also used to subcluster epithelial cells.

```{r functions-integration}
run_seurat_integration <- function(obj, methods = c("harmony", "rpca")) {
  obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
  obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$SampleID)
  obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj)
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, vars.to.regress = regress_vars)
  obj <- RunPCA(obj, npcs = 50)
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50, reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

  if ("harmony" %in% methods) {
    obj <- IntegrateLayers(obj, method = HarmonyIntegration,
                           orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony")
    obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:50, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
  }
  if ("rpca" %in% methods) {
    obj <- IntegrateLayers(obj, method = RPCAIntegration,
                           orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "rpca")
    obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "rpca", dims = 1:50, reduction.name = "umap.rpca")
  }
  JoinLayers(obj)
}

# iNMF with rliger; the factor loadings are added to the Seurat object as reduction "inmf"
run_inmf <- function(obj, k = 30) {
  obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$SampleID)
  lig <- as.liger(obj, assay = "RNA", organism = "mouse")
  lig <- removeMissing(lig, minFeatures = 100)
  lig <- rliger::normalize(lig)
  lig <- selectGenes(lig, nGenes = 1000)
  lig <- scaleNotCenter(lig)
  lig <- runIntegration(lig, k = k)
  lig <- alignFactors(lig, method = "centroidAlign")

  emb <- Embeddings(ligerToSeurat(lig), "inmf")
  obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
  if (all(rownames(emb) %in% colnames(obj))) {
    obj <- subset(obj, cells = rownames(emb))
    emb <- emb[colnames(obj), ]
  } else {
    # rliger renamed the cells; it keeps them in the same order as the input object
    stopifnot(nrow(emb) == ncol(obj))
    rownames(emb) <- colnames(obj)
  }
  obj[["inmf"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = emb, key = "iNMF_", assay = "RNA")
  obj
}

cluster_leiden <- function(obj, reduction, dims, k, resolutions) {
  obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = reduction, dims = dims, k.param = k)
  for (res in resolutions) {
    obj <- FindClusters(obj, graph.name = "RNA_snn", algorithm = 4, group.singletons = TRUE,
                        resolution = res, cluster.name = paste0("Leiden_", res))
  }
  obj
}

plot_resolutions <- function(obj, reduction, resolutions, file) {
  plots <- lapply(resolutions, function(res) {
    DimPlot(obj, reduction = reduction, group.by = paste0("Leiden_", res), label = TRUE) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Leiden ", res)) + NoLegend()
  })
  ggsave(file, wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2), width = 12, height = 4 * ceiling(length(plots) / 2))
}

# Positive markers ranked by a combined score of significance, fold change and detection difference
rank_markers <- function(obj, group_by) {
  FindAllMarkers(obj, group.by = group_by, assay = "RNA", only.pos = TRUE,
                 logfc.threshold = 0.1, min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2,
                 max.cells.per.ident = 1000) %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(pct.diff = pct.1 - pct.2,
           combined_score = -log10(p_val_adj) * abs(avg_log2FC) * abs(pct.diff),
           combined_score = ifelse(is.infinite(combined_score),
                                   max(combined_score[is.finite(combined_score)]),
                                   combined_score)) %>%
    arrange(cluster, desc(combined_score))
}

annotate_clusters <- function(obj, cluster_col, labels) {
  names(labels) <- as.character(seq_along(labels))
  unname(labels[as.character(obj[[cluster_col, drop = TRUE]])])
}

umap_theme <- function() {
  theme_classic() +
    theme_dr(xlength = 0.22, ylength = 0.22,
             arrow = grid::arrow(length = unit(0.15, "inches"), type = "closed")) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}
```

```{r integration}
DATA <- run_seurat_integration(DATA)
DATA <- run_inmf(DATA)
DATA <- RunUMAP(DATA, reduction = "inmf", dims = 1:30, min.dist = 0.3, reduction.name = "umap.inmf")

p <- wrap_plots(
  DimPlot(DATA, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = "SampleID", shuffle = TRUE) + ggtitle("Unintegrated"),
  DimPlot(DATA, reduction = "umap.harmony",      group.by = "SampleID", shuffle = TRUE) + ggtitle("Harmony"),
  DimPlot(DATA, reduction = "umap.rpca",         group.by = "SampleID", shuffle = TRUE) + ggtitle("RPCA"),
  DimPlot(DATA, reduction = "umap.inmf",         group.by = "SampleID", shuffle = TRUE) + ggtitle("iNMF"),
  ncol = 2)
ggsave(file.path(qc_dir, "Integration_comparison.pdf"), p, width = 14, height = 10)

saveRDS(DATA, file.path(obj_dir, "02_integrated.rds"))
```

## Major cell types

```{r major-clusters}
resolutions <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2)
DATA <- cluster_leiden(DATA, reduction = "inmf", dims = 1:30, k = 25, resolutions = resolutions)
plot_resolutions(DATA, "umap.inmf", resolutions,
                 file.path(results_dir, "annotation", "Major_clusters_resolutions.pdf"))

markers_major <- rank_markers(DATA, "Leiden_0.25")
write.csv(markers_major, file.path(results_dir, "annotation", "Major_cluster_markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

DotPlot(DATA, group.by = "Leiden_0.25",
        features = c("Mobp", "Mag", "Ptprc", "Tmem119", "Col3a1", "Col1a1", "Olig2", "Tnr",
                     "Rbfox3", "Grin2b", "Aqp4", "Gfap", "Pecam1", "Adgrl4", "Sox6", "Slc35f1",
                     "Dnah12", "Ccdc162", "Mpz", "Pmp22", "Abcc9", "Cald1", "Pdgfrb", "Kcnj8",
                     "Rgs5", "Foxj1", "Ttr", "Krt8", "Krt18", "Otx2", "Aqp1", "Folr1", "Mrc1",
                     "Cx3cr1", "Cd3d", "Cd3e", "Cd19", "Alox15", "Top2a", "Mki67", "Acta2")) +

```

```{r major-annotation}
celltype_levels <- c("Epithelial Cells", "Fibroblasts", "Endothelial Cells", "SMCs",
                     "Ependymal Cells", "Immune Cells", "Neuron", "Astrocytes",
                     "Oligo/Schwann cells", "Pinealocytes")

# Leiden_0.25 clusters 1-19
DATA$Celltypes <- annotate_clusters(DATA, "Leiden_0.25", c(
  "Epithelial Cells", "Epithelial Cells", "Epithelial Cells", "Fibroblasts",
  "Fibroblasts", "Epithelial Cells", "Neuron", "Epithelial Cells",
  "Epithelial Cells", "Immune Cells", "Fibroblasts", "Neuron",
  "Endothelial Cells", "Pinealocytes", "Astrocytes", "Oligo/Schwann cells",
  "Fibroblasts", "Immune Cells", "Epithelial Cells"))
```

## Subclustering

The subtype labels are written back to the full object; clusters that turn out to belong to another lineage update `Celltypes` as well.

### Immune cells

```{r immune}
immune <- subset(DATA, subset = Celltypes == "Immune Cells")
immune <- cluster_leiden(immune, reduction = "inmf", dims = 1:30, k = 15,
                         resolutions = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1))
plot_resolutions(immune, "umap.inmf", c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                 file.path(results_dir, "annotation", "Immune_clusters_resolutions.pdf"))

# Leiden_0.5 clusters 6 and 8 are not immune cells and are removed from the dataset
removed_immune <- colnames(immune)[immune$Leiden_0.5 %in% c("6", "8")]
immune <- subset(immune, cells = removed_immune, invert = TRUE)

immune <- cluster_leiden(immune, reduction = "inmf", dims = 1:30, k = 15,
                         resolutions = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1))
plot_resolutions(immune, "umap.inmf", c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                 file.path(results_dir, "annotation", "Immune_clusters_refined.pdf"))

# Leiden_0.75 clusters 1-11
immune$Subtypes <- annotate_clusters(immune, "Leiden_0.75", c(
  "Ccr2+ Macrophages", "Ccr2- Macrophages", "T Cells", "Ccr2+ Monocytes",
  "Ccr2+ Monocytes", "Ccr2- Macrophages", "Osteoclast", "Ccr2- Macrophages",
  "S100a8+ Cells", "cDendritic Cells", "ILCs/NK Cells"))

DATA <- subset(DATA, cells = removed_immune, invert = TRUE)
DATA@meta.data[colnames(immune), "Subtypes"] <- immune$Subtypes
```

### Fibroblasts

```{r fibroblasts}
fb <- subset(DATA, subset = Celltypes == "Fibroblasts")
fb <- cluster_leiden(fb, reduction = "inmf", dims = 1:30, k = 15,
                     resolutions = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1))
plot_resolutions(fb, "umap.inmf", c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                 file.path(results_dir, "annotation", "Fibroblast_clusters_resolutions.pdf"))

# Leiden_0.5 clusters 1-13
fb$Subtypes <- annotate_clusters(fb, "Leiden_0.5", c(
  "Dural Fibroblast", "Leptomeningeal Fibroblast", "Arachnoid Fibroblasts",
  "Periosteal Fibroblast", "Leptomeningeal Fibroblast", "Dural Fibroblast",
  "Periosteal Fibroblast", "Choroid plexus Fibroblast", "SMCs",
  "Arachnoid Barrier Cells", "Dural Fibroblast", "Ependymal Cells", "Neuron"))

DATA@meta.data[colnames(fb), "Subtypes"] <- fb$Subtypes
moved <- colnames(fb)[fb$Subtypes %in% c("SMCs", "Ependymal Cells", "Neuron")]
DATA@meta.data[moved, "Celltypes"] <- fb@meta.data[moved, "Subtypes"]
```

### Epithelial cells

```{r epithelia}
epi <- subset(DATA, subset = Celltypes == "Epithelial Cells")
epi <- cluster_leiden(epi, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, k = 15,
                      resolutions = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5))
plot_resolutions(epi, "umap.inmf", c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5),
                 file.path(results_dir, "annotation", "Epithelial_clusters_resolutions.pdf"))

markers_epi <- rank_markers(epi, "Leiden_0.25")
DotPlot(epi, group.by = "Leiden_0.25",
        features = rev(unique(group_by(markers_epi, cluster) %>% slice_head(n = 5) %>% pull(gene)))) +
  coord_flip()

# Leiden_0.25 clusters 1-9
epi$Subtypes <- annotate_clusters(epi, "Leiden_0.25", c(
  "Cuboidal Epithelial Cells", "Cuboidal Epithelial Cells", "Multicilia Epithelial Cells",
  "Multicilia Epithelial Cells", "Cuboidal Epithelial Cells", "T Cells",
  "OB Epithelium", "Ependymal Cells", "ILCs/NK Cells"))

DATA@meta.data[colnames(epi), "Subtypes"] <- epi$Subtypes
DATA@meta.data[colnames(epi)[epi$Subtypes %in% c("T Cells", "ILCs/NK Cells")], "Celltypes"] <- "Immune Cells"
DATA@meta.data[colnames(epi)[epi$Subtypes == "Ependymal Cells"], "Celltypes"] <- "Ependymal Cells"
```

## Remove neuronal contamination and re-integrate

Nuclei with high *Fgf14* expression outside the neural clusters are treated as contamination from brain parenchyma and removed. The remaining nuclei are integrated again; cell-type labels are kept.

```{r fgf14}
VlnPlot(DATA, features = "Fgf14", group.by = "SampleID", pt.size = 0) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.35, linetype = "dashed")

neural <- c("Neuron", "Pinealocytes", "Ependymal Cells", "Astrocytes")
fgf14  <- FetchData(DATA, vars = "Fgf14", layer = "data")$Fgf14
contaminated <- colnames(DATA)[fgf14 > 0.35 & !DATA$Celltypes %in% neural]
table(DATA$Celltypes[contaminated])

DATA <- subset(DATA, cells = contaminated, invert = TRUE)
```

```{r reintegration}
DATA <- run_seurat_integration(DATA, methods = "harmony")
DATA <- run_inmf(DATA)
DATA <- RunUMAP(DATA, reduction = "inmf", dims = 1:30, min.dist = 0.3, reduction.name = "umap.inmf")
```

## Final object

```{r final-object}
subtype_levels <- c(
  "Cuboidal Epithelial Cells", "Multicilia Epithelial Cells", "Ependymal Cells", "OB Epithelium",
  "Dural Fibroblast", "Leptomeningeal Fibroblast", "Arachnoid Fibroblasts", "Arachnoid Barrier Cells",
  "Choroid plexus Fibroblast", "Periosteal Fibroblast", "SMCs", "Endothelial Cells",
  "Ccr2- Macrophages", "Ccr2+ Monocytes", "Ccr2+ Macrophages", "T Cells", "cDendritic Cells",
  "Osteoclast", "ILCs/NK Cells", "S100a8+ Cells",
  "Neuron", "Oligo/Schwann cells", "Pinealocytes", "Astrocytes")

DATA$Celltypes <- factor(DATA$Celltypes, levels = celltype_levels)
DATA$Subtypes  <- factor(DATA$Subtypes,  levels = subtype_levels)
stopifnot(!anyNA(DATA$Celltypes), !anyNA(DATA$Subtypes))

DATA$Condition <- ifelse(DATA$Group == "Ctrl", "PBS", "AEC")

saveRDS(DATA, file.path(obj_dir, "03_annotated.rds"))

# Cell annotations, for deposition with the processed data
DATA@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, SampleID, Group, Celltypes, Subtypes) %>%
  write.csv(file.path(results_dir, "cell_annotations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Cell-type proportions

Neural cell types (parenchymal contamination) are excluded.

```{r proportion-functions}
plot_proportions <- function(meta, var, name) {
  props <- meta %>%
    dplyr::count(Group, .data[[var]]) %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()
  write.csv(props, file.path(results_dir, "annotation", paste0("Proportions_", name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  p <- ggplot(props, aes(x = Group, y = prop, fill = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_alluvium(aes(alluvium = .data[[var]]), alpha = 0.7, colour = "black") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of nuclei", fill = NULL) +
    cowplot::theme_minimal_hgrid() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "annotation", paste0("Proportions_", name, ".pdf")), p, width = 10, height = 7)

  p
}
```

```{r proportions-celltypes}
border <- subset(DATA, subset = Celltypes %in% c("Neuron", "Pinealocytes", "Oligo/Schwann cells", "Astrocytes"),
                 invert = TRUE)
border$Celltypes <- droplevels(border$Celltypes)
border$Subtypes  <- droplevels(border$Subtypes)
border <- RunUMAP(border, reduction = "inmf", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.inmf")

p <- DimPlot(border, reduction = "umap.inmf", group.by = "Celltypes",
             alpha = 0.6, pt.size = 0.1, shuffle = TRUE, raster = FALSE) + umap_theme()
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "annotation", "Celltypes_clean.pdf"), p, width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 600)

p <- DotPlot(border, group.by = "Celltypes",
             features = rev(c("Clic6", "Kcnj13", "Col1a2", "Lama2", "Pecam1", "Adgrl4", "Acta2", "Myh11",
                              "Ccdc162", "Dnah12", "Ptprc", "Ly86"))) +
  coord_flip() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "annotation", "Celltype_markers_clean.pdf"), p, width = 5, height = 5.5)

plot_proportions(border@meta.data, "Celltypes", "Celltypes")

# Border cells only, used by the advanced analysis
saveRDS(border, file.path(obj_dir, "04_border_cells.rds"))
```

### Subtypes of immune cells, fibroblasts and epithelial cells

```{r subtype-figures}
subtype_figures <- function(celltype, name, markers, umap_dims = 1:30, min_dist = 0.3) {
  obj <- subset(border, subset = Celltypes == celltype)
  obj$Subtypes <- droplevels(obj$Subtypes)
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "inmf", dims = umap_dims, min.dist = min_dist,
                 metric = "euclidean", reduction.name = "umap.inmf")

  p <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.inmf", group.by = "Subtypes",
               alpha = 0.8, pt.size = 1, shuffle = TRUE, raster = FALSE) + umap_theme()
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "annotation", paste0(name, "_subtypes.pdf")), p, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600)

  write.csv(rank_markers(obj, "Subtypes"),
            file.path(results_dir, "annotation", paste0(name, "_subtype_markers.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  p <- DotPlot(obj, group.by = "Subtypes", features = rev(unique(markers))) +
    coord_flip() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "annotation", paste0(name, "_subtype_markers.pdf")), p, width = 5, height = 5.5)

  plot_proportions(obj@meta.data, "Subtypes", name)
  invisible(obj)
}

subtype_figures("Immune Cells", "Immune",
                c("Mrc1", "Maf", "Ccr2", "Ly6c2", "Adgre1", "S100a9", "Cxcr2", "Atp6v0d2",
                  "Ctsk", "Ciita", "Zbtb46", "Cd247", "Cd3e", "Ccl1", "Xcl1"))
subtype_figures("Fibroblasts", "Fibroblasts",
                c("Slc47a1", "Slc26a7", "Il34", "Slc7a11", "Crabp2", "Aldh1a2", "Wnt6",
                  "Dpp4", "Cldn11", "Dpep1", "Inmt", "Runx2", "Satb2"))
subtype_figures("Epithelial Cells", "Epithelial",
                c("Folr1", "Aqp1", "Otx2", "Gmnc", "Glis3", "Spag16"),
                umap_dims = 1:25)
```

## Changes over time

### Genes changed in each cell type

Genes higher at each time point than in the other time points, per cell type.

```{r condition-celltypes}
for (ct in levels(border$Celltypes)) {
  obj <- subset(border, subset = Celltypes == ct)
  markers <- rank_markers(obj, "Group")
  if (nrow(markers) == 0) next
  write.csv(markers, file.path(results_dir, "condition", paste0("Group_markers_", ct, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  top5 <- markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_head(n = 5) %>% pull(gene)
  p <- DotPlot(obj, features = unique(rev(top5)), group.by = "Group") + coord_flip()
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "condition", paste0("Group_markers_", ct, ".pdf")), p, width = 6, height = 7, dpi = 600)
}
```

### D1 vs Ctrl per subtype, with GSEA

```{r condition-subtypes}
gsea_terms <- c("response to external biotic stimulus", "response to other organism",
                "biological process involved in interspecies interaction between organisms",
                "response to stress", "cytokine production", "regulation of innate immune response",
                "granulocyte migration", "myeloid leukocyte migration", "regulation of chemokine production",
                "granulocyte chemotaxis", "leukocyte activation involved in immune response",
                "interleukin-1 beta production", "response to interferon-beta")

for (st in levels(border$Subtypes)) {
  n_d1   <- sum(border$Subtypes == st & border$Group == "D1")
  n_ctrl <- sum(border$Subtypes == st & border$Group == "Ctrl")
  if (min(n_d1, n_ctrl) < 20) {
    message("Skipping ", st, ": too few nuclei (D1 ", n_d1, ", Ctrl ", n_ctrl, ")"); next
  }
  obj <- subset(border, subset = Subtypes == st & Group %in% c("D1", "Ctrl"))
  Idents(obj) <- "Group"

  # All genes, so that GSEA ranks the whole transcriptome
  de <- FindMarkers(obj, ident.1 = "D1", ident.2 = "Ctrl", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.05) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene")
  write.csv(de, file.path(results_dir, "condition", paste0("D1_vs_Ctrl_", st, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  sig <- dplyr::filter(de, p_val_adj < 0.05)
  message(st, ": ", nrow(sig), " DEGs")
  if (nrow(sig) > 0) {
    top <- sig %>% group_by(up = avg_log2FC > 0) %>% slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC), n = 5) %>% pull(gene)
    p <- DotPlot(obj, features = unique(rev(top)), group.by = "Group") + coord_flip()
    ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "condition", paste0("D1_vs_Ctrl_", st, ".pdf")), p, width = 6, height = 7, dpi = 600)
  }

  ranks <- sort(setNames(de$avg_log2FC, de$gene), decreasing = TRUE)
  gse <- gseGO(ranks, ont = "ALL", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL",
               by = "fgsea", eps = 0, seed = TRUE)
  write.csv(gse@result, file.path(results_dir, "condition", paste0("D1_vs_Ctrl_", st, "_GSEA.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  shown <- intersect(gsea_terms, gse@result$Description[gse@result$p.adjust < 0.05])
  if (length(shown) > 0) {
    p <- dotplot(gse, showCategory = shown, x = "NES") + ggtitle(paste(st, "GSEA, D1 vs Ctrl"))
    ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "condition", paste0("D1_vs_Ctrl_", st, "_GSEA.pdf")), p, width = 6, height = 7, dpi = 600)
  }
}
```
